claims.hypothesis: Are [C II] and dust continuum detectable and resolved in z~6 quasar hosts, indicating compact star formation?
claims.experiment: ALMA Cycle 0 extended-array observations of five quasars; 2-D Gaussian fits
claims.result: All five detected; marginally resolved with [C II] 0.3-0.6'' and continuum 0.2-0.4''
claims.finding: Vigorous star formation over the central few kpc

evidence.quote: These measurements indicate that there is vigorous star formation over the central few kpc in the quasar host galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Do z~6 quasar hosts have [C II]/FIR ratios like other high-z quasar-starbursts and local ULIRGs?
claims.finding: Comparable to local ULIRGs and other high-z quasars

evidence.quote: which is comparable to the values found in other high-redshift quasar-starburst systems and local ultra-luminous infrared galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Is the SMBH-to-bulge mass ratio at z~6 higher than local?
claims.experiment: Rotating-disk Mdyn from [C II] and Eddington-based MBH
claims.finding: Ratios an order of magnitude higher than local, with caveats on Mdyn and morphology

evidence.quote: the mass ratios between the SMBHs and the spheroidal bulge are an order of magnitude higher than the mean value found in local spheroidal galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Are there serendipitous [C II] emitters around the quasars?
claims.experiment: Bayesian line search in the cubes
claims.finding: Volume too small to constrain the luminosity function

evidence.loc: 4.3 Search for [CII] line emitters associated with the quasar environments
evidence.quote: At the current sensitivity the volume sampled is not sufficient to place constraints on the possible evolution of the luminosity function out to $\rm z \sim 6$

why_this_data.value: ALMA Cycle 0 gives sub-arcsec resolution and sensitivity to detect [C II] in an hour; sources chosen as bright in mm continuum and CO with Dec <= +20.

evidence.quote: Thus, the Cycle 0 phase of ALMA opens a unique opportunity to expand the observation of [C II] line emission to a large sample of quasar-starburst systems at the highest redshift.

limitations_admitted.value: Limited resolution gives only constraints on size; morphology uncertain, large errors on minor axis and PA affect inclination and Mdyn.

evidence.loc: 4.2 Dynamical masses traced by the [C II] line emission
evidence.quote: there are still large uncertainties in the intrinsic source morphology measurements; the deconvolved minor axis and position angle measurements of some of the objects show large error bars.

limitations_admitted.value: [C II] may trace only the central starburst, underestimating bulge mass.

evidence.loc: 4.2 Dynamical masses traced by the [C II] line emission
evidence.quote: This may underestimate the total masses within the spheroidal stellar bulges.

referee_caveats_inferred: Dynamical masses depend on a crude inclination from poorly constrained axis ratios and an assumed disk.
MBH assumes Eddington accretion, which biases MBH/Mdyn.
Velocity gradients could arise from mergers or outflows rather than rotation.
No imaging parameters, so beams and fluxes cannot be reproduced exactly.
